signatures.description: Implement a leveled LSM compaction planner that selects overlapping file sets per level while honoring per-snapshot pins: a deletion tombstone may be dropped only when it shadows every older version of that key in all lower levels and no live snapshot pins the deleted version, and range-deleted files must be expanded to exact key boundaries before overlap tests. Report per-compaction bytes_read/bytes_written write-amplification accounting and apply each manifest change as a single atomic edit record with a monotonic edit number so a crash between plan and apply leaves a consistent manifest. Given a synthetic keyspace with out-of-order sequence numbers, three live snapshots, and partially overlapping range tombstones, return the exact compaction plan and assert that no dropped tombstone is observable by any pinned snapshot.
